sentences.text: The present petition was last taken up for hearing on 20.02.2026, when learned counsel for the parties addressed arguments regarding the quashing of the FIR on the basis of compromise.

2. However, upon perusal of the case papers, I notice that the status report indicates that an allegation under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ['IPC'] has been added against one of the accused - Riyazuddin [petitioner No.8 herein], based on the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
The question of whether the FIR can at all be quashed on the basis of a compromise, therefore, requires further consideration.
3. The prosecutrix is, however, unrepresented today.
The Investigating Officer is directed to apprise her of the pendency of this petition.
She may appear in person or be represented by counsel on the This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 27/02/2026 at 20:47:03 next date of hearing.
4.
The order sheets reveal that the prosecutrix has been represented by counsel in the course of these proceedings.
Accordingly, notice may be issued to her through the counsel appearing on her behalf as well.
